campaignInfo.optInWorkflow: Residents opt in on the Rapid Cortex citizen camera registration page, hosted by their local public safety agency. They enter their mobile number and check a box reading: 'I agree to receive SMS from Rapid Cortex on behalf of my public safety agency about emergencies near my registered camera. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.' The number is only messaged when an incident is dispatched near a camera that resident registered.
campaignInfo.optInMessage: Rapid Cortex: You are subscribed to emergency camera access requests from your public safety agency. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to opt out.
campaignInfo.helpMessage: Rapid Cortex emergency camera access. Support: REPLACE support@example.com or REPLACE +15555550100. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.
campaignInfo.stopMessage: Rapid Cortex: You are unsubscribed and will receive no further messages. Reply START to resubscribe.
